title_en: In the Courtroom (12/20): The Factory Pollution Case
note_en: 无论…都… means "no matter whether/what…, still…": 无论是不是故意的，工厂都需要为污染负责 "whether or not it was deliberate, the factory has to answer for the pollution." The 无论 clause must contain an open question (an A-not-A form like 是不是, a question word, or two options), and 都 in the main clause is required, placed after the subject (工厂都…).
